Name: Cornucopia More Crops Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod features a combination of original artwork and edited assets from Cometkins's visual mods. The cucumber and zucchini sprites are based on Silkylamb's better crops and foraging for SVE cucumber sprite. Furthermore, the design decisions were inspired by the crop names used in Vegas' Item Compatibility Patch, which is why the persimmon is pointy. 

I have finally retextured the crop growth phases and the giant crops, but they're mainly recolors. 98% of the seeds still aren't retextured. The only exceptions are the seeds for bamboo, wasabi root, and sapodilla. I also edited some of the previous sprites so that the color palettes are more cohesive and the sprites look better overall.

Furthermore, this mod is configurable. You can choose which icons you want to retexture. Note: This visual mod conflicts with SeaSea50's Cornucopia Retexture in Vanilla Tweaks Style. That mod will completely overwrite the retextures of this mod unless you disable the changes of the other mod in its config. 

Please report any errors you experience, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.

Shout out to passersby10086 for making the i18n!
